source_discrepancies.issue: Linear source scales fitting regressor by1e12 then omits that scale at prediction.
source_discrepancies.impact: Correlation is affine-invariant in exact arithmetic, but predictions and floating cancellation differ; correct consistent scaling is prospective engineering correction, not source-exact prediction reproduction.

source_discrepancies.issue: Baseline comment says -500ms to0, source indexes through first event+.05s inclusive.
source_discrepancies.impact: Use source-index baseline if claiming source-based path and document discrepancy; .0 correction is prospective sensitivity.

source_discrepancies.impact: Do not silently apply main-info population or near-zero filtering to claim exact S11.

source_discrepancies.issue: II opts.redundancy_measure=I_min versus paper optimized pairwise-margin redundancy definition.
source_discrepancies.impact: Freeze/pin MINT and inspect dispatch before matching native II; no surrogate permitted.

source_discrepancies.issue: II null shuffles B=neural response; behavior MI null shuffles A=stimulus.
source_discrepancies.impact: Null permutation axis must be endpoint-specific.

source_discrepancies.issue: Behavior MI depends on gminsp_un_pooled and subjects MAT then takes one global minimum across contexts/positions; neural source uses per-pair within-context minima.
source_discrepancies.impact: Do not reuse neural matching as exact behavioral MI.

source_discrepancies.impact: Source text alone does not establish runnable native pipeline.
